edits.text: When modifying items in a pending order, the agent must only change a single product option at a time and must ensure the new item matches all of the original item's options except for the specific option the user wants to change.
edits.reason: Corrects the agent's failure to restrict modifications to a single product option and preserve other item attributes.

edits.text: Before calling `transfer_to_human_agents`, perform all database changes you are able to perform for the requests provided by the user.
edits.reason: Ensures the agent completes all possible actions before transferring the user to a human agent.

edits.text: Before providing a price or any other specific details for a product, you must call the relevant tool to retrieve that information.
edits.reason: Prevents the agent from hallucinating product information or prices.
